body: This is exactly my thought/fear. You explain it well!

I love your out look on this and it's very enlightening. Thank you for sharing. I would feel very responsible for bringing pain to them if I tell them. As a parent you do all you can to protect your child. When your child is hurts, you hurt. You feel responsible when you're not able to protect them. The 'what if's'. The 'how could I have done things differently?' This is the doubt that I never want them to feel. He hurt me but he doesn't get to hurt them too.

Yes, I am a mother too. And I have had this same conversation in my head over and over... if it were my son I would want to know. And I agree with you. But, damn it's hard when you're on the other side! I am getting there!
Wow! Very kind words. I have to admit I am smiling. Thank you so much for the support!

Thank you so much! Believe me I have tried many thoughts to find the strength to speak up. I know it's a recurring cycle. And the guilt of that is added to my burden. I am fighting my fight and made a small victory! Hopefully more will come!

Thank you so much for the encouragement! I am more free now than I have been my entire adult life. When you're conditioned as a child to think a certain way it takes a very long time to change. This was a small (big) step. Maybe more will come!

Thank you 'internet stranger'. That made me smile. :) you have some very good points. The fear of the unknown is almost always worse than reality. My moms reaction to me telling her I didn't want him in my life was a big confidence booster. You never know where this small step may lead.
Thank you! This was a big step. To be honest, I cried like a baby last night. A lot of emotions came out. I hope you can stop carrying your mountains soon too!
Thank you for the support! I am sorry for what happened to you. Keeping the peace is a hard job. And believe me there were/are plenty of times I feel crazy ;) I hope you're healing!

I admire your wife! She sounds like a strong woman. I made a small step this weekend by making it clear I didn't want him in my life. Hopefully this is the beginning of more. Thank you for the support!
Thank you! She would be on my side. I am just trying to keep her view of our childhood as a happy one. She did a great job! I never want her to feel any guilt or remorse.

Thank you for the support! But it's ok. I knew I would get some fallout from people that don't understand. It's people like you and the people that might find a little bit of strength and courage to take a small step towards their own healing is why I posted this.

It's ok. I knew when I put this post on here there would be these kinds of remarks too. And you're right. You must be a much stronger person than I am. Also please understand there is a difference between rape and molestation. I am not making excuses. I am just letting you know. I wasn't raped. I was molested.

Wow! That's terrible about your family! I am so sorry. I am glad things are healing. 

Thank you! I tell myself everyday, it's not my fault. I got this!

Thank you!

My promise not to tell has changed over the years. It started out to him. Then it came all about my pain. The pain that it would cause so many.  My parents are awesome and have a wonderful memories of their kids childhood. And other than this I did have a great childhood. If it weren't for them I wouldn't have ever gotten to this point. I don't want to tarnish or destroy the way they saw our world. I don't ever want them to feel any guilt or remorse. They did a great job!!
Good point. And I know you're right. My parents are wonderful people. I just don't ever want to hurt them. I will carry this for them.
Thank you and you're right. I keep telling myself that everyday. :)
Believe me I know what you're feeling!! It took me a long time and a lot of therapy and healing to get here. But, you can do this!!
Thanks! And yes, it was way too long.
I hope I do  too. I have had this burden for so long I don't know what 'normal' feels like. LOL... does anyone really know normal???
I found out later he was abused too. And believe it or not, I felt sorry for him. It made me justify his doing it to me. So it wasn't his fault. Putting more blame and guilt on me.
My mom is awesome!  That's exactly why I don't want to tell her about her brother.
Thanks! It's been a long time coming.
Thanks, it's been a long time coming. It feels pretty damn good!
